name: Docker Build Check
description: Validates Dockerfile syntax and best practices before docker build commands are executed
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Validate Dockerfile before docker build
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'docker\s+build'; then
  DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile"
  if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE -- '-f\s+\S+'; then
    DOCKERFILE=$(echo "$COMMAND" | sed -n 's/.*-f\s\+\(\S\+\).*/\1/p')
  fi
  if [[ ! -f "$DOCKERFILE" ]]; then
    echo "BLOCKED: Dockerfile not found: $DOCKERFILE"
    exit 2
  fi
  if command -v hadolint &>/dev/null; then
    hadolint "$DOCKERFILE" 2>&1
  fi
fi
exit 0
